answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of the participant’s commitment and a future drand quicknet pulse, so its unpredictable value cannot be known when work is prepared. A marble-specific task may ask an agent to wander through a search space, while the pulse serves as an anchor for verification. This blocks advance precomputation and offline farming across many identities; it raises Sybil costs but does not alone prevent identities acting online after the pulse.
